```bash
echo "set nu" >> ~/.vimrc
```

Note: `set nu` is a shorthand for `set number`.

## Additional Tip

You may also find `set relativenumber` useful - this shows relative line numbers (showing how many lines you are from the top/bottom of the file). This can be added alongside `set number` in your .vimrc file if you want both absolute and relative line numbers.
